task_description: Step 2 of the Quant Feed roadmap: replace the prototype's react-force-graph-3d with a custom high-performance React Three Fiber / Three.js WebGL engine (single InstancedMesh nodes, custom shaders, fat-line edges with flow shader, SDF labels with LOD, eased camera, time-axis Z projection, semantic LOD), move the force-directed layout to a Web Worker (d3-force-3d), and keep all scene data in plain typed arrays owned by a vanilla Zustand store OUTSIDE React with dirty-range GPU updates and free-list slot recycling. Add a dark HUD overlay (inspector drawer, entity filters, sentiment heatmap, event-sequence timeline). Add real-time WebSocket graph diffs: a FastAPI WS gateway with a server-side per-client filter predicate fanning out Redis-published diffs, and a client that streams diffs into the store - all feature-flagged and gracefully falling back to the existing /api/graph REST path when unset/unreachable. Scoped to Step 2 only; NO Graph-RAG/auth/billing (Step 3). Do NOT push or open PRs; work stays on branch feat/step2-webgl-engine.

verification.summary: After the review-v1 fix commit (989192d): Frontend `bun run build` exit 0; `bun run lint` fully clean (the two pre-existing NetworkGraph warnings are gone because the file was removed); `bun test` 49 pass / 0 fail across 7 files (store diff-apply/free-list/capacity/dirty-range + new remove-only-diff draw-count regression + slot->id reverse-map, visual mapping, forceSimClient SSR no-op, canvas-mount smoke, realtime ws-config + graphSocket). Backend `uv run ruff check .` clean, `uv run mypy .` clean (47 files), `uv run pytest` 64 passed (test_ws_gateway.py + test_ingest_diff.py incl. cumulative-edge tests, all using InMemoryDiffPublisher + TestClient.websocket_connect, no live infra). Grep gate: no `react-force-graph-3d` or `components/NetworkGraph` references remain in app/components/lib. Test quality reviewed and confirmed revert-sensitive by the semantic reviewer: free-list slot reuse asserts the exact recycled index; the remove-only-diff test fails if draw count reverts to liveCount; capacity-drop leaves existing slots intact; the WS tests assert the server-side predicate drops non-intersecting diffs, filter-update takes effect without reconnect, and the exact camelCase {addedNodes,removedNodes,updatedEdges} contract; the cumulative-edge test fails if the producer reverts to per-run scored_edges. docker_build skipped: only the backend has a Dockerfile and the sandbox's broken container networking (Step 1 finding) means a built image cannot validate the live Redis/WS runtime, so it would not meaningfully verify Step 2. Semantic review: v1 NEEDS_CHANGES (2 blocking + 4 minor issues), v2 APPROVED after fixes. CANNOT be validated in-sandbox (needs the user's real browser+GPU and managed Redis/backend): 60 FPS with ~5k nodes/~15k edges, actual shader compile/visual correctness, real d3-force-3d worker ticks + camera-controls feel, and the live end-to-end ingestion -> managed Redis pub/sub -> WS gateway -> browser diff loop.
